'''''Lilium brownii''''' is a species of [[lily]] native to [[mainland China]], [[Hong Kong]],<ref name=grin/> [[Kinmen]] and [[Matsu Islands]]<ref name=air2010/> as well as northern and central [[Vietnam]]<ref name=aver2016/> and [[Kachin State|Kachin]] of [[Myanmar]].<ref name=kress2003/> Its common names include '''Hong Kong lily''' and '''Brown's lily'''.<ref name=grin/>

==Botanical varieties==
There are two accepted [[Variety (botany)|varieties]] of ''L. brownii'':<ref name=foc/>

* ''L. brownii'' var. ''brownii'': leaves lanceolate to linear, known as "wild lily" (野百合) in China.
*''Lilium brownii var. chloraster'' (Baker) Baker
* [[Lilium brownii var. viridulum|''L. brownii'' var. ''viridulum'']]: leaves oblanceolate to obovate, known as "(common) lily" (百合) in China. This variety is often cultivated for its edible bulbs.
